Hak Anak adalah bagian dari hak asasi manusia yang wajib dijamin, dilindungi, dan dipenuhi oleh Orangtua, Keluarga, masyarakat, negara, pemerintah, dan pemerintah daerah.

Kekerasan terhadap perempuan adalah setiap tindakan berdasarkan perbedaan jenis kelamin yang berakibat atau mungkin berakibat kesengsaraan atau penderitaan perempuan secara fisik, seksual atau psikologis, termasuk ancaman tindakan tertentu, pemaksaan atau perampasan kemerdekaan secara sewenang-wenang, baik yang terjadi di ranah publik atau dalam kehidupan pribadi.

Kekerasan terhadap anak adalah setiap perbuatan terhadap anak yang berakibat timbulnya kesengsaraan atau penderitaan secara fisik, mental, seksual, psikologis, termasuk penelantaran dan perlakuan buruk yang mengancam integritas tubuh dan merendahkan martabat anak.

Pusat Pelayanan Terpadu Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak yang selanjutnya disingkat P2TP2A adalah jejaring kerjasama yang menyelenggarakan fungsi pelayanan terpadu perlindungan perempuan dan anak.

Lembaga Sosial Kemasyarakatan adalah Lembaga Swadaya Masyarakat (LSM) dan/atau organisasi kemasyarakatan lainnya.

Komisi Perlindungan Anak Daerah yang selanjutnya disingkat KPAD adalah unit pelayanan sosial terpadu yang melaksanakan pelayanan perlindungan anak untuk mewujudkan pemenuhan hak-hak anak.

Diskriminasi adalah setiap pembatasan, pelecehan, atau pengucilan yang langsung ataupun tak langsung didasarkan pada pembedaan manusia atas dasar agama, suku, ras, etnik, kelompok, golongan, status sosial, status ekonomi, jenis kelamin, bahasa, keyakinan politik. yang berakibat pengurangan, penyimpangan atau penghapusan pengakuan, pelaksanaan atau penggunaan hak asasi manusia dan kebebasan dasar dalam kehidupan baik individual maupun kolektif dalam bidang politik, ekonomi, hukum, sosial, budaya. dan aspek kehidupan lainnya.

Rumah Aman (Shelter) adalah rumah perlindungan bagi perempuan dan anak termasuk keluarga dan saksi korban kekerasan.

1.6.evidence: prevent marriage at child age; and provide character education and instillation of moral values in children.
1.6.rationale: The policy explicitly addresses a harmful practice by stating an obligation to “prevent marriage at child age,” which falls squarely under early/child marriage in the coding rules.
1.6.evidence_original: mencegah terjadinya perkawinan pada usia anak; dan memberikan pendidikan karakter dan penanaman nilai budi pekerti pada anak.

1.7.rationale: None of the candidate sentences mention femicide/feminicide, gender-motivated killing of women, or any femicide-specific legal framework or measures; the text only discusses violence in general terms.

1.8.evidence: The Regional Government provides special protection for child victims of trafficking as referred to in Article 37 letter e and child victims of abduction as referred to in Article 37 letter g which is carried out through efforts of: supervision;
1.8.rationale: The policy explicitly refers to “child victims of trafficking” and provides special protection measures for them, which directly satisfies inclusion of trafficking in persons.
1.8.evidence_original: Pemerintah Daerah memberikan perlindungan khusus bagi anak korban trafficking sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 37 huruf e dan  anak korban penculikan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 37 huruf g yang dilakukan melalui upaya: pengawasan;

1.9.evidence: The Regional Government provides special protection for children exploited economically and/or sexually as referred to in Article 37 letter d and child victims of violence both physical and mental as referred to in Article 37 letter h.
1.9.rationale: The policy explicitly includes “children exploited … sexually” and provides special protection for them, which constitutes explicit coverage of sexual exploitation under the coding rules (even without using the term sexual slavery).
1.9.evidence_original: Pemerintah Daerah memberikan perlindungan khusus bagi anak yang tereksploitasi secara ekonomi dan/atau seksual sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 37 huruf d dan anak korban kekerasan baik fisik maupun mental sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 37 huruf h.

1.10.rationale: The only technology-related provision concerns regulating internet/game businesses and blocking pornographic sites, but it does not recognize cyber/online/digital abuse, harassment, bullying, or online sexual exploitation as forms of violence; per the coding rules, such administrative/technical measures alone are insufficient.

2.1.evidence:
Efforts to prevent violence against women shall be carried out in an integrated manner by the Regional Government coordinated by the agency having the duties and functions of coordination in the field of women's empowerment and child protection.
Prevention efforts as referred to in paragraph (1), shall be implemented through the following means: forming networks in efforts to prevent violence;
2.1.rationale: The policy explicitly states that prevention efforts for violence against women are carried out in an integrated manner by the Regional Government and coordinated by a designated agency, and it specifies “forming networks” and coordination/integration/synchronization as implementation means—meeting the requirement for a formal coordination mechanism/network rather than only assigning isolated responsibilities.
2.1.evidence_original:
Upaya pencegahan kekerasan terhadap perempuan dilakukan secara terpadu oleh Pemerintah Daerah yang dikoordinasikan oleh instansi yang mempunyai tugas dan fungsi koordinasi di bidang pemberdayaan perempuan dan perlindungan anak.

Upaya pencegahan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1), dilaksanakan melalui cara: membentuk jaringan kerja dalam upaya pencegahan kekerasan;

2.2.evidence:
Maintenance of neglected children as referred to in paragraph (1), can also be carried out by individuals and non-governmental institutions or community institutions.
Government institutions, and/or individuals, and/or community institutions in providing services as referred to in paragraph (2), may cooperate with various related service units.
2.2.rationale: The text explicitly recognizes non-governmental institutions/community institutions as actors that can carry out maintenance and care, and it states that government institutions/individuals/community institutions may cooperate with related service units—constituting an explicit cooperation mechanism involving non-government providers.
2.2.evidence_original:
Pemeliharaan anak terlantar sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1), juga dapat dilakukan oleh perorangan dan lembaga non pemerintah atau lembaga kemasyarakatan.

Lembaga pemerintah, dan/atau perorangan, dan/atu lembaga kemasyarakatan dalam memberikan pelayanan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2), dapat melakukan kerjasama dengan berbagai unit layanan terkait.

2.3.rationale: The candidate sentences mention community reporting and monitoring/supervision, and “monitoring and recording” appears in relation to the development of children in conflict with the law, but none of the provided sentences explicitly establish/assign a system or responsibility to collect/manage data specifically on violence against women, VAW victims, or VAW cases as required by the coding rules.

2.4.rationale: The policy explicitly requires the Regional Government to conduct gender mainstreaming and describes institutional/coordination functions for it (establishing implementation, coordinating/facilitating/mediating, and strengthening/developing gender mainstreaming mechanisms in institutions), which constitutes institutionalisation of gender mainstreaming as an implementation mechanism.

2.5.rationale: The only explicit “training” reference is skills/job training as part of women’s economic empowerment, which is excluded by the coding rules (victim/women livelihood training is not implementation capacity building). Other passages discuss institutional strengthening for gender mainstreaming and fostering/supervision, but do not explicitly mandate training/technical guidance/professional development for implementing officials or service providers for policy implementation.

2.6.evidence: conducting monitoring and supervision of the Protection of Women and Children from acts of violence, exploitation, trafficking and discrimination;
2.6.rationale: The policy explicitly includes “monitoring and supervision” by the community in the implementation of protection of women and children from violence/exploitation/trafficking/discrimination, which constitutes monitoring of implementation/service delivery (even if not a full formal M&E framework).
2.6.evidence_original: melakukan pemantauan dan pengawasan terhadap Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak tindak kekerasan, eksploitasi, trafficking dan diskriminasi;

3.1.evidence:
P2TP2A is one form of integrated service unit, which functions as:
service center for women and children victims of violence; and empowerment center for women and children.
3.1.rationale: The policy explicitly identifies P2TP2A as an integrated service unit and specifies that it functions as a service center for women and children victims of violence, which meets the requirement for an integrated VAW victim service mechanism.

P2TP2A adalah salah satu bentuk unit pelayanan terpadu, yang berfungsi sebagai:

pusat pelayanan bagi perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan; dan pusat pemberdayaan bagi perempuan dan anak.

3.2.rationale: The candidate sentences mention police only in general definitions of protection and do not identify any specialised police-based unit (e.g., UPPA/RPK) or a dedicated police office unit providing specialised services for women victims of violence.

3.3.evidence: building complaint and service units regarding violence against women at the sub-district, village and/or Lembang levels; and campaigns for awareness, socialization and education to the community regarding the protection and empowerment of women.
3.3.rationale: The policy mandates the establishment of complaint and service units regarding violence against women at sub-district/village levels, which constitutes a mechanism for receiving reports/complaints of violence.

Protection for women victims also includes the provision of safe houses as temporary shelters to obtain a sense of security during the judicial process and/or outside the judicial process.
The provision of protection and safe houses shall be carried out by the Regional Government.
